title: Dangote Cement aiming to list in London from November 2026
summary: Dangote Cement aiming to list in London from November 2026
body_markdown: **Nigeria/UK:** Dangote Cement is preparing to list on the London Stock Exchange from November 2026. It has added Goldman Sachs Group and UBS Group as bookrunners, according sources contacted by Bloomberg. The cement company intends to raise around US$1bn by selling a 10% share in the group. The timing of the stock market listing is variable and is dependent on market conditions. Investor engagement events are expected to start in late-October 2026 to raise interest in the listing. Bloomberg added that Dangote Cement, Goldman and UBS declined to comment on the report. Dangote Petroleum Refinery and Petrochemicals raised US$2.5bn in a private placement earlier in 2026.
